headline: 12 Michigan deals, $674.3M raised — led by RHP Partners IV, LP

top_deals.summary: RHP Partners IV, LP, a Farmington Hills-based private equity fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $642.8M sold to 14 investors. (Amended filing.)
Freedom Partners No. 3, LLC, a West Bloomfield-based private equity fund, disclosed a $50M raise; $9.2M sold to 9 investors.
Noblestone Credit Select II LLC, a Southfield-based real estate company, filed a $25M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $1.9M sold to 10 investors.
Inngest Inc., a Royal Oak-based technology company, filed a $20.5M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $20.5M sold to 7 investors.

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $674.3M sold across 6 Form D filings this week, up 1314% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Noblestone Credit Select II LLC (Southfield, Other Real Estate) targeting $25M. Good question to ask: are founders in real estate favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?

Steelcase Inc (SCS) closed a transaction. It was one of 2 M&A filings this week. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan manufacturing & automotive assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

4 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $652M raised so far — led by RHP Partners IV, LP (Private Equity Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
